bundaberg.text: Sugar city on Burnett River, about 4.5 hours from Brisbane
Home of Bundaberg Rum and Bundaberg Ginger Beer
Botanic Gardens hold Hinkler Hall of Aviation honouring Bert Hinkler
Hummock gives views over city and out to sea
Mon Repos and Bargara on beaches about 10 km away
Southern gateway to the Great Barrier Reef, reef trips to Lady Musgrave and Lady Elliot
Tour the rum distillery and ginger beer brewery
Mon Repos turtles lay from about December, hatchlings to about February, at night, ranger only
bundaberg.fix: Official Mon Repos season (usually Nov-Mar) not checked; bundabergregion.com.au unavailable. Wording 'around' is fine.

bundaberg.text: Bargara has most of the beachside accommodation
bundaberg.fix: Wikivoyage says Bargara has many apartments and resorts; 'most' is stronger than source. Change to 'has many of the beachside stays'.

bundaberg.text: Best months May-Oct, mild and dry
bundaberg.fix: No guidebook best-time line. Flag as inference from climate; cite a guide or keep flagged.

kgari.text: About 122 km long, formerly Fraser Island, World Heritage 1992, off southern Queensland coast
Over 100 freshwater lakes, coloured sand cliffs, rainforest on dunes
Most of it is Great Sandy National Park
Main beach is a highway for 4WDs passing Eli Creek, SS Maheno wreck and Indian Head
kgari.source: https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/K'gari (beach classed as highway; See list)

kgari.text: Dingoes live wild; keep food secured, never feed them
kgari.fix: Advice supported by Wikivoyage only; QPWS blocked (403).

kgari.text: Every vehicle travelling to K'gari needs a permit on the windscreen; campers outside commercial campgrounds need a camping permit
kgari.fix: Supported verbatim by Wikivoyage (undated, QPWS blocked). Keep, but 'Get both before you go' is advice not in source: acceptable, or cut.

kgari.text: Vehicles cross by barge from River Heads or Inskip Point; sand roads need 4WD; allow about three days
kgari.fix: Source says 'ferry'/'barge' and 'three days'; 'take a guided tour if unsure' supported (tour recommended if uncomfortable driving).
Figure is from undated Wikivoyage and QPWS (blocked) could not confirm; penalty is likely higher now. Cut the amount: 'Feeding dingoes is fined.'

kgari.text: Skip ocean swimming, surf and sharks a risk
Spot rays, turtles and dolphins from headlands

https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/K'gari (Platypus Bay, tours from Hervey Bay)

Hamilton Island busiest in Sep-Oct and Christmas
